task: Tune the inbound rate limiter on the orders API after a misconfiguration caused 429 storms during peak traffic. Candidate pool from a 195-entry store across gateway, orders, and capacity projects.

candidate_memories.content: Post-incident review confirmed rate limiter was set to 50 req/s per IP; correct value per capacity plan is 200 req/s.
Rate limiter config lives in api-gateway/config/ratelimit.yaml; update per_ip_rps under orders_api and restart the gateway pod.
Rate limit changes require load-test validation in staging before production deployment; use locust/orders_peak_scenario.py.
After any rate limit change, monitor 429 rate on the orders API for 10 min; acceptable 429 rate is <0.5%.
payment-svc has a separate rate limiter at 100 req/s per IP; not part of this incident.
Orders API p99 latency is 120 ms at the corrected rate; well within SLO.
API quota limits for third-party partners are configured separately in the partner portal, not in ratelimit.yaml.
Old capacity plan from 2023 set orders API limit to 100 req/s; superseded by 2025 capacity review.
candidate_memories.notes: stale: 2023 capacity plan superseded by 2025 review

candidate_memories.content: DDOS protection at the CDN level throttles to 10 000 req/s across all IPs; not a factor in this incident.
Circuit breaker on orders-svc downstream calls trips at 30% error rate over 10 s; independent of rate limiting.
Incident post-mortem is in progress in #incident-orders; final report due by EOD.
Rate limit changes must be documented in the API capacity register before deployment; add an entry in docs/capacity.md.
